payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterative DP over elements, maintaining a 1D array of counts for possible signed sums of subarrays ending at current position.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a single array `dp` of size O(totalSum) to count ways to achieve each sum, updating it per element in O(n*totalSum). There's no two-dimensional state indexing. Accumulates dp[m] for subarray sums zero resetting start points via increment.
